about: Reserved voi.ci names (docs/voici-namespace-spec.md, Reserved words). Each is a `reserved` row of the names registry, so it and its look-alikes (same safety key) can't be taken as a username, a link name or a code. Extend the list here, not in code: migration 0127 seeded these, and `.com`'s names job adds any new word on its next run (a word already taken is left out and logged; settle it by hand). Removing a word here does not free it. The list is the spec's seed plus the words that were already refused for DNS or system reasons (the old username and link-name lists).
